messages:
Nora (Design): dropping a new sketch: move invoice CTA into a small persistent "hotspot" beside the scope selector so it's always visible when scanning spend rows. also proposing a densify toggle in preferences instead of cluttering the toolbar. figma link in thread.
Ben (PM): finance asked that download be discoverable. hotspot sounds good if keyboard + mobile are covered. can you show mobile header behavior?
Nora (Design): mobile -> hotspot becomes a full-width header button labeled "Download invoice (PDF/CSV)". desktop -> icon+label in hotspot.
Kai (FE): implementation note: ensure hotspot is the second tab stop after scope. on narrow widths collapse left rail to icon-only at <=960px.
Priya (Eng): performance: stick only the hotspot container, not each row. virtualize rows for large result sets. adding a show_fiat flag for compact mode so we don't inflate payloads.
Sam (Content): CTA copy candidate: "Download invoice (PDF / CSV)". tooltip: "Includes cached & prefix-reused tokens". aria-label: "Download billing invoice for selected scope and period".
a11y-bot: Reminder: scope toggle needs aria-pressed; hotspot button must be reachable within two tab stops and have an aria-describedby for the tooltip. consider aria-live when scope changes.
Nora (Design): visual nits: add a 1px divider between sparkline and token stack; increase token numeral contrast to pass AA. densify preference will reduce padding and stack token over fiat.
Kai (FE): for token pill behavior on mobile, use tap to toggle fiat. desktop use hover. also add a showFiat prop to avoid reflows.
Priya (Eng): backend ok to add show_fiat query param. will default to false for heavy queries and true for first page.
Ben (PM): sprint decision: implement hotspot + accessibility requirements now; densify preference and lazy fiat in next sprint. acceptance: invoice reachable within two tab stops, mobile header button present, aria labels and tooltip implemented.
Nora (Design): action items: update Figma with hotspot, add mobile variant, annotate ARIA strings.
Kai (FE): I'll draft component API and keyboard order.
Priya (Eng): I'll add virtualization + API flag docs.
Sam (Content): I'll finalize localized strings.
Nora (Design): added to tomorrow's design review agenda ":thumbsup:"
